main_body: A rectangular green hedge/bush block, 16 px wide and 15 px tall. It has a lighter leafy top and a darker front face.
top_band: Light green (#689e63, L≈135) at rows 1-5, speckled with lighter dots, under a 1-row dark outline at row 0. It is separated from the front by a step of about 54 L.
evidence: In column x=16 the scan reads outline (row 0), light top (rows 1-5, L=135), an abrupt drop to the mid-green front (rows 6-10, L=81), then a dark base (rows 11-14, L=55). The 5-row top is a clear horizontal surface and the step to the front face is over 25 L. At x=8 a transitional row 5 (L=106) softens the edge. For a hedge, an organic shape with no doors or drawers, this reads as a top surface above a front face and is not a rim-only or flat-band cap. There is no distinct edge line or eave shadow, but that is acceptable for foliage.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 17-20 per tile and 38-40 colours in the references. The outline is a dark green tint (4% neutral), which is correct. The top has a few light speckles and the front has scattered dark dots, but the surfaces are sparse and blocky. There are no leaf clumps, no per-tile highlights and no silhouette variation, so it looks much thinner than the Beodeul references.
